items.q: There are 4 trays with 6 rolls on each tray. How many rolls are there in all?
misconceptions: added the trays and the rolls instead of multiplying
items.why: 4 trays with 6 rolls on each is 4 equal groups of 6, so multiply: 4 × 6 = 24. Skip-count to check: 6, 12, 18, 24.

items.q: A gardener plants 7 rows of 8 seeds. How many seeds does the gardener plant?
misconceptions: added the rows and the seeds instead of multiplying
items.why: 7 rows with 8 seeds in each row is 7 equal groups of 8, so multiply: 7 × 8 = 56.

misconceptions: wrote the two part answers side by side instead of adding
items.why: Split 24 into 20 and 4. Then 20 × 3 = 60 and 4 × 3 = 12, and 60 + 12 = 72.

items.q: 24 cookies are shared equally among 6 friends. How many cookies does each friend get?
misconceptions: took the friends away from the cookies
guessed a share without sharing the cookies out
items.why: Share the 24 cookies into 6 equal shares. Each friend gets 4, because 6 × 4 = 24.

misconceptions: rounded the share up and lost the leftover
kept a leftover big enough for another round
items.why: 4 × 23 = 92, and 95 - 92 leaves 3 over. The 3 left is less than 4, so there is not enough for another round: 23 remainder 3.

items.q: 27 students ride in vans that hold 6 students each. How many vans are needed so every student can ride?
misconceptions: counted the seats, not the vans
added the students and seats instead of grouping
items.why: 27 students fill 4 vans of 6, which is 24 students, and 3 students are left over. Those 3 still need a ride, so you need a fifth van.
Use the doubling trick: 7 × 4 = 28, and double 28 is 56. So 7 × 8 = 56.

items.q: Which choice is the same as 8 × 6?
items.why: Turning an array changes nothing: 8 rows of 6 hold as many as 6 rows of 8. Both are 48.

items.q: Mia knows 6 × 8 = 48. What is 48 divided by 8?
misconceptions: repeated the 8 instead of finding the missing factor
kept the whole 48 and shared nothing
grabbed a far fact: 4 × 8 is only 32
items.why: Facts travel in families. If 6 × 8 = 48, then 48 shared by 8 is 6.
